speechOptions.instruction: Calm, confident, measured — short declarative sentences, like a good product keynote. No exclamation marks in delivery, no salesy energy. Let the pauses between sentences breathe.

title: MulmoTerminal — answer the amber one (v5, choreographed take)
description: v5. Six cells, all agents, driven on camera with prompts TYPED one character at a time; the top-middle turns amber and the app's own synthesized chime lands on that frame. One camera arc (push in, hold, pull out) split across the first two beats so nothing cuts. See mulmoterminal-60s-v5-NOTES.md.
